args.name: Controlled small heat source
args.function: Create and operate a small controllable heat source for nearby physical heating trials, with a way to extinguish it safely.
args.conditions: My root heat probe failed at tick 12 because no actual available heat source was within reach. I am outdoors on ordinary soil, health 100, energy 39.3, holding 2.9 roots. Fallen branches and weathered stone are visible nearby but have not been gathered or physically tested. No ignition tool or fuel properties are established.
args.inputs: Potential nearby branches and stone, only if their actual properties support the method; any ignition materials or tools must be identified and acquired. Preserve food reserves.
args.costs: Unknown ignition method, required materials, learning time, operating effort and fuel consumption; specify a minimal feasible method or report missing prerequisites.
args.effects: An actual limited heat source that nearby heat probes can use, with explicit fuel, duration, reach, burn and spread risks, and extinguishing behavior. No automatic cooking, safety improvement, preservation or reward.

candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"wren\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general small-source combustion operation with ignition, tending, inspection and extinguishing modes. The retained heat/ignition searches found only probe or no matches. probe can characterize materials and test an existing heat source, but cannot create combustion; gather, pickup and navigate acquire or reach real inputs without providing ignition. No equivalent source-creation capability is established. Wren presently has neither verified suitable fuel nor an ignition method, so development must not create a fire, grant supplies or assert that nearby branches or stones will work. Missing thermal and combustion mechanisms belong in the current-conversation development handoff, not a permanent rejection.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: operate-small-combustion-source(target, mode, fuelItemIds, tinderItemIds, ignitionMode, toolItemIds, quantity, durationRounds, extinguishingItemIds). Modes: attempt-ignition, tend, inspect and extinguish. Any applicable actor may learn it; all targets and inputs are explicit references, not actor-specific bindings. Record reuse of foundation-forest@1 forest.gather/base:gather:1, pickup/base:pickup:1, navigate/base:navigate:1 and probe/open-baseline:probe:1 rather than reimplementing or claiming those functions as inventions. Gathering, travel and tests are separate charged actions. Reference existing heat probes through the source's public thermal-target record; do not invent a registry ID for an unavailable heat-probe contract.\\nPrerequisites and minimal mechanism: an actual reachable site on firm noncombustible ground, actual possessed fuel/tinder and an independently executable ignition method. Ordinary soil is a candidate site, not proof that nearby litter is safe. First implement direct friction as a bounded ignition attempt only where actual supplied pieces have suitable contact geometry and grip; bare hands provide work, not spontaneous sparks. Do not assume stone strikes produce sparks, invent cordage or tools, or silently manufacture a fire drill. Unsuitable geometry, moisture or insufficient work may make this attempt fail. Another ignition mode may accept an already hot physical target if one actually exists. If required geometry or material properties cannot be represented, return an explicit missing prerequisite and send that minimal representation to this same development handoff; no source appears. Existing probe supplies observations and small-sample tests at its established costs, with uncertainty retained. Nearby branches and weathered stone must be addressed by actual discovered object IDs, reached, gathered if appropriate and tested; their presence conveys no usable stock or properties. Wren's item-4-wren-39 is 2.9 roots, not ignition material or fuel under this request: exclude food inputs.\\nExecution contract: validate reach, ownership/authority for consumed items, quantities, site and mode before charging or reserving anything. Input IDs resolve to persistent objects; use exact stack splits preserving origin, mass, moisture, condition and prior treatment. Initial version limits the fuel bed to a 0.2 m radius and heat-probe interaction reach to 0.65 m; the latter is an access bound, not guaranteed effective heating. Require represented fuel mass, moisture and combustion/ignition properties before calculating a burn. Missing values remain unknown and require supported measurement or explicit development of their representation, never disclosure of hidden resource locations. Unknown suitability does not authorize an assumed successful ignition.\\nCosts and progress: individual study is 4 simulation rounds, with no supplied materials or mastery beyond completion. An ignition attempt lasts the requested 1–5 rounds, costs 1 energy per active round, and applies no more than that round's explicit mechanical-work budget to the contact patch. Mechanical work is deducted from actor energy using the simulation's declared energy conversion; if no conversion exists, implementing that ledger is a blocking dependency. Only actual retained contact heat can initiate combustion after moisture loss and ignition requirements are met. Friction wear and evaporation consume measured material/water, not a fixed fictitious success charge. Reserve only explicitly selected input quantities. Tending or starting a hot-target ignition takes 1 round and 0.5 energy; inspection reuses probe observation, 1 round and 0.2 energy. Extinguishing takes 1 round and 0.5 energy plus the actual selected extinguishing material or tool use. Insufficient energy or unreachable targets prevents the action before charging. Learning and development/review waiting do not advance the world; only actual study/actions do.\\nBlocking implementation dependencies are a local mass/thermal ledger, material ignition and burn rules, environmental oxygen/heat loss, actual heat transfer to nearby objects, and quench/smother/burn-risk handling. Implement these minimal mechanisms together in the existing handoff, not as future era unlocks. Declare and version their coefficients and units before enabling execution. Per simulation step, combustion consumes only present dry combustible mass and locally available oxygen, releases at most consumed fuel mass times its represented heat yield, and produces accounted ash and exhaust; evaporated water is recorded as vapour. Allocate released energy among retained heat, nearby heat transfer and environmental losses without duplication. Fuel consumption and duration are calculated from those rules and actual inputs, not promised by this review. A query may report an estimate with its assumptions, never a guaranteed burn duration. Heat probes receive actual time-varying local exposure, not a magic heating flag.\\nControl and safety: tending may add explicitly charged fuel, separate burning pieces with a real suitable tool, or reduce air using a physically adequate cover. It cannot set an arbitrary temperature. Quenching needs acquired water or other proven suitable material in sufficient quantity and an actual delivery method; smothering needs a real suitable cover or adequate noncombustible covering material. Consume/translocate those inputs and model cooling or oxygen exclusion. Ordinary nearby soil alone does not imply gathered extinguishing stock. Before ignition require an executable extinguishing option and inspect the reachable surroundings for exposed combustibles; this reduces risk but grants no safety immunity. Heat exposure can burn actors, ignite represented susceptible nearby material, or leave dangerous embers according to the same rules. If a compatible spread/hazard model is absent, that is a blocking dependency, not permission to run consequence-free fire. Extinguishing success requires observable absence of combustion and an explicit residual-temperature reading; flames disappearing alone may leave hot embers.\\nA lit source is a persistent world process that burns each simulation step without continued commands until fuel/oxygen is exhausted or actual extinguishing succeeds. It needs replenished fuel and periodic observation for continued controlled use; no indefinite output. Leaving, cancelling, interruption or death does not switch it off. Active work stops on loss of reach, incapacity, insufficient energy, cancellation or death. Save completed friction work and input changes; retained heat still cools through ordinary simulation, so resuming does not preserve stale ignition progress. Release surviving reserved inputs once on cancellation; consumed fuel, effort, wear and elapsed time are never refunded. Death leaves physical tools, fuel and source under ordinary world item rules. A failed preflight has no charge; a performed but failed attempt retains its real costs, warmed/worn materials and informative measurements. No automatic cooking, preservation, nutrition, improved safety, consent or transfer occurs. No other actor is recruited or controlled; any helper must independently communicate and execute their own actions.\",\"learning\":4,\"experienceReview\":\"Requests, queries, registration, development, naming and completion of study award no pleasure or satisfaction. Default source-operation reward is zero. A personally relevant verified measurement, including evidence that a friction attempt failed under measured conditions, may qualify only through established event-based information-gain rules: deduplicate by actor, tested function, material and conditions, not capability name or repeated probe calls. If such rules are absent, implement an opt-in event consumer with at most one 0.1 short-pleasure increment per substantively distinct verified result, capped at 0.2 across 10 rounds, decaying to zero over those 10 rounds; no grant merely for spending effort. Familiar successful tending may qualify for maintained satisfaction only when a real personally applicable heating use occurred: at most 0.04 per round, one qualifying contribution per actor per round across functionally equivalent activities, satisfaction capped at 1 and decaying by 0.002 per elapsed round without maintenance. No benefit is guaranteed for Wren. Thermal comfort requires measured personal exposure and physiological applicability, is capped at 10 across sources, and must decrease with overheating or burn risk rather than reward hazardous heat. Basic nutrition is unaffected by mood. Never alter protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions; use only an authorized existing experience interface, otherwise leave rewards at zero. Encode eligibility, deduplication, caps, cooldown and decay in code rather than repeated model review.\",\"visualReview\":\"Use reusable metadata linked to a persistent source ID, location, footprint, fuel quantity, active mode, work progress, flame intensity, smoke, ember state, exposed temperature, residue and hazard radius. Emit observable events for friction contact, measured heating, verified ignition, fuel addition, quench/smother actions, flame-out and verified cooling, with input/output object references and evidence timestamps. Render flame only when combustion actually begins; smoke and embers require their corresponding physical states. A failed attempt may show movement, wear or measured warming, never a successful fire, extinguished-safe badge or heating success. Hot remains remain visually distinct from verified cold residue. Visual effects do not independently grant functional heat, experience or knowledge; measurements and uncertainty remain separate from presentation.\"}]}"}
